name: agent-loop-sidecar-tcp-binding
about: pilotdeck.yaml 的 modules.agentLoop 绑定 module-tcp-v2（parseModulesConfig.ts:227-238）而不设部署环境变量：会话的 agentLoopBinding（SessionAgentConfigBundle.ts:157-158）让 createAgentLoopBindingFactory（AgentLoopDeploymentProfile.ts:107-127）按绑定的 host / port / connectTimeoutMs 连外部 sidecar，并以 implementationId 作为握手时要求的模块身份（agentLoopSidecarClient.ts:810-813）。implementationId 写成 sidecar 实际的 pilotdeck-agent-loop，一轮带工具调用的对话照常走 TCP sidecar。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
modules:
  agentLoop:
    enabled: true
    implementationId: pilotdeck-agent-loop
    contract: pilotdeck.agent-loop/v1
    transport: module-tcp-v2
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 38414
    connectTimeoutMs: 2000
